register: # ADDRESS SHIFT: the register column holds the Modbus PDU (wire) address, which is the vendor's printed register number minus 1 (SunSpec and Fronius number registers from 1, so the SunSpec marker 'SunS' is register 40001 and is read at address 40000). The rows in this file were shifted by -1 for that reason. To compare a row with the vendor document, add 1 to its register (for example Fronius lists total AC power as 40092 and it is read at 40091).

# CORRECTED: the common-model string rows were rotated by one field in the original (options sat on Vr, version on SN, serial_number past the end). They now use the SunSpec positions Opt 40036, Vr 40044 and SN 40052. This comes from the SunSpec standard, not from the vendor's documentation.

# NOT VERIFIED: the SolarEdge battery block (62836 and above) is not part of the SunSpec chain; those addresses look like decimal conversions of SolarEdge's hexadecimal addresses, which are already wire addresses, and were left alone. battery_1_voltage and battery_1_soe currently share register 62852. Rows between 40131 and 44999 follow the vendor chain and were not checked against a device.

# MIXED BASES FOUND: only the rows up to dc_power_sf (vendor registers 40001-40102) used the vendor's 1-based numbers and were shifted. From inverter_temperature (40103) on, including the nameplate rows at 40121-40125, the original numbers already equalled the SunSpec wire addresses (for example operating_state 40107, alarm_1 40109) and were left alone; a blanket -1 would have broken them.

# SCALING: values that SunSpec scales by a scale-factor register now carry a Context adjustment that reads that register (10**SF, SF -10..10), so they publish in real units (A, V, W, Hz, Wh, C). The *_sf registers are still published. A scale factor of 0x8000 (not implemented) leaves the raw value. Writable rows are not scaled (a Context scaling cannot be inverted on a write).

# DYNAMIC MAP: rows whose register column is [anchor+offset] are template rows. The anchors come from the SunSpec model chain the device reports (discovery in the protocol JSON) and fall back to the discovery_defaults in that JSON, which reproduce the fixed layout this file used before, so nothing changes until a device reports something different. {i} repeats a row once per instance found. Meter and early-StorEdge battery rows exist only when discovery finds them. See documentation/architecture/dynamic_register_discovery.md.

register: # SolarEdge grid-tied inverters — all models with SetApp configuration or firmware 3.xxxx+
# Interface A: Modbus TCP port 502 (disabled by default; enable in SetApp: Site Communication → Modbus TCP)
# Interface B: Modbus RTU RS485; default 115200 baud 8N1 (configurable 9600-115200 bps)
#   Enable: SetApp → Commissioning → Site Communication → RS485-1 → Protocol → SunSpec (Non-SE Logger)
#   Set RS485-1 → Device ID to unique unit ID (1-247)
# IMPORTANT: SolarEdge supports ONE Modbus master at a time — either RTU or TCP
# Protocol: SunSpec integer + scale factor model (IDs 101/102/103)
# Register addressing: the register column is the PDU address (vendor register number minus 1); see the notes at the top
# All multi-register values: big-endian (high register first); apply SF register as value x 10^SF
